title: Elektron Wrought Alloys: conventional WE43 physical properties
notes: WE43 row in Physical properties of magnesium wrought alloys, read through the indexed primary PDF table; direct PDF download returned a challenge page. Specific gravity 1.84 at 20 C; conductivity 51 W/m/K at 20 C; specific heat 966 J/kg/K over 20-100 C. Used only as constant conventional-alloy references for an uncalibrated macro thermal study, not as LPBF powder, molten or temperature-dependent properties. No source document redistributed.
